column3: “In formation” renders each on his ways.
“Defenses” renders weapons; “never breaking ranks” specifies not being cut off.
Thieves is plural instead of singular thief.
“Those who obey” renders a singular doer of His word.
Hearts is plural instead of singular heart; sending is supplied with disaster.
Grain and drink offerings are plural instead of singular.
Scorn among nations renders nations ruling over them.
Army, front ranks, and rear guard specify the northerner, his face, and his end.
“Open pastures” renders pastures of the wilderness; best renders strength.
“Children” renders sons; vindication renders righteousness, and “as before” renders in the beginning.
The locust forms are specified by their actions or stages.
